messages.subject: Re: Bug about defining Inf and -Inf
parts:
Dear Cheng,

Sorry for inconvenience. 

1. My suspect is that sometimes older version of Bioconductor v3.3 with older version of MSstats, v.3.4 can be installed even though you installed from bioconductor. (Bioconductor version should be v3.4) So, maybe version v3.6 could be not v3.6, maybe older version. Could you check from msstats.log files, which version you used before? I will try to find any easy solution for this installation issue from Bioconductor.

2. On my side, I can not generate the same issue as you. The results of v3.6 and v3.7.1 are the same. But v3.4 vs (v3.6 and v3.7.1) are different. If you can share with your data, result that you had before, result that you have now, I can check.

- Meena

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: Bug about defining Inf and -Inf
parts:
Dear Cheng,

Thank you for sharing the data.
I found that 
- your previous result was with v3.3.12 or v3.4 (not 3.6)
- the results with v3.6 and v3.7.1 are the same except Inf, -Inf.
- As you pointed out, there was the issue for distinguish between Inf, -Inf. So, If I count the proteins with FDR < 0.05, FC > 1.5 or FC < -1.5, v 3.4 and v3.7.1 has quite similar number of proteins. I checked the 8 proteins which have different results in MCP1 vs MCP3. That was due to new strategy for censored missing value.
- the fold change estimation and p-value are different in v3.4 and in v3.7.1 due to different strategy for missing value.

Hope to help.

- Meena
